name: Rent Top Apartments near Plaza de Catalunya
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Rent Top Apartments near Plaza de Catalunya. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Rent Top Apartments Passeig de Gràcia offers apartments set close to Las Ramblas and Plaza Catalunya, or in the Born district. Each bright, stylish apartment has a fully equipped kitchen, free Wi-Fi and air conditioning.

All Rent Top apartments have elegant minimalist décor and a spacious lounge with a flat-screen TV. Kitchens feature a ceramic hob, dishwasher and washer-dryer. Bed linen and towels are provided.

Rent Top Apartments Passeig de Gràcia is situated in central Barcelona, surrounded by shops, restaurants and bars. Las Ramblas, Plaza de Catalunya and the Gothic Quarter are within walking distance of the apartments.

Catalunya Station offers Metro and local train services. Direct buses to Barcelona Airport also stop in the square.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

Cot and extra bed policies 0 - 2 years Cot upon request 3+ years Extra bed upon request Prices for cots are not included in the total price, and will have to be paid for separately during your stay. The number of cots allowed is dependent on the option you choose. Please check your selected option for more information. There are no extra beds available at this property. All cots are subject to availability.

hostInfo.name: Rent Top Apartments
hostInfo.welcomeMessage: These completely exclusive apartments combine great taste and style with the original antiquity and story of this remarkable Barcelona building located in the heart of the city next to Catalunya Square and Paseo de Gracia. After a long day the fabulous interior and atmosphere is incredibly relaxing and replenishing. The apartments are completely equipped with everything you need to feel at home away from home.
hostInfo.ownerInfo: Rent Top Apartments offers carefully selected apartments providing hotel-alternative housing solutions in the best locations in Barcelona, whatever the purpose of your trip, business or pleasure. The exclusiveness of our apartments is combined with a high-quality service for our clients to enjoy comforts of a home in our holiday apartments.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: If you are keen to explore everything Barcelona center has to offer this is definitely the choice for you. The famous Las Ramblas starts just the other side of the square. Also, just on the doorstep is Paseo de Gracia, Rambla Catalunya, Plaza Universitat and the main shopping street Portal del Angel. You can get around the city easily with bus, metro and taxi station all in the vicinity. If you prefer to wander around on foot this is perfect to discover the winding streets of the Gothic and Raval quarters or see the Cathedral or Picasso museum in the fashionable Borne district. This apartment is a true oasis in one of the most popular city destinations in Europe.
hostInfo.familyTips: Ideal location for a family city-break!
